title: Koala waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='8' y='78' width='84' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='8' y='78' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#B07A45'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='13' fill='#9AA5B1'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='8' fill='#D8C0C8'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='13' fill='#9AA5B1'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='8' fill='#D8C0C8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#9AA5B1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#C9D2DA'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#AEB8C4'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#C9D2DA'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2E3A4B'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2E3A4B'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#3B4657'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47.5' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#6B7788'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 55 Q50 60 56 55' stroke='#4A5666' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving arm (right side) -->
  <path d='M72 60 Q86 48 84 32' stroke='#9AA5B1' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='30' r='6' fill='#AEB8C4'/>
  <!-- paw pads -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='28' r='1.4' fill='#C9D2DA'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='28' r='1.4' fill='#C9D2DA'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#C9D2DA'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q20 70 24 76' stroke='#9AA5B1' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='77' r='5.5' fill='#AEB8C4'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#AEB8C4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#AEB8C4'/>
</svg>
